description: Fetch the latest stored backlink summary for a domain the caller tracks (total backlinks, referring domains, domain rating). Returns has_data:false if no snapshot exists yet; it never triggers a new fetch. A domain that is not one of the caller's tracked sites returns an error. Free: spends no credits.

domain.description: The domain to fetch backlink stats for, e.g. example.com.

name: get_backlink_summary
title: Get backlink summary
